text.p: Primadonna Resorts Inc on Tuesday said it was renaming its flagship Primadonna Resort & Casino to reflect its new positioning as a destination resort for the golf and business-conference markets.
The new name of the property, located about 40 miles west of Las Vegas, is the Primm Valley Resort & Casino.

The Primadonna previously relied on car traffic from Interstate 15, the main thoroughfare from Southern California to Las Vegas. But the opening of the Primm Valley Golf Club in February, combined with a hotel and casino renovation program, is expected to change the customer mix, the company said.

"We are moving beyond the traffic intercept strategy and are in the throes of creating a destination resort complex that will be second to none," Gary Primm, the company's chief executive, said in a statement.
Marketing with the golf club is expected to boost midweek occupancy, broaden target markets, increase length of stays and tap into Las Vegas for visitors and local customers.
In 1996, all 660 rooms at the hotel were renovated. Most of the renovation and retheming of public areas is expected to be completed by autumn.
A new Primm Valley casino will boost floor space by nearly 50 percent. A new conference area adjacent to the casino will have a capacity of 1,250.
Primadonna shares were up 3/8 at 19-1/8 by midafternoon Tuesday.
